name: XDYou
tagline: Free and Open Source data assistant for XDU students.
blurb: "XDYou" is a Free and Open Source personal data assistant for XDU students.
description:
"XDYou" is a Free and Open Source personal data assistant for XDU students.

This software is originally called "Traintime PDA".

- Both undergraduates and postgraduates are supported.
- View classtable with exam arrangement and experiment arrangement, also set your idol as the background.
- View sport related data: sport class detail and test score.
- Check your dorm's electricity balance and check your historical electricity usage.
- View your grade, easily calculate GPA and average score by choosing the subjects.
- View the exam schedule.
- View the due time of the borrowed books and query the details of the books in the library.
- View the bill you spent in the cafeteria, use the payment code if your card have money.
- Empty classroom check.
- Physics experiment schedule check and output it to iCalendar.
- School forum Ruisi support.
- Schoolnet Query.
- Attendance Query.
- Homepage arrangement notice widget.
- i18n support with Traditional Chinese and English.
- iLife789 support
- Notice before class.

If you got some idea about it, contact me freely.
